The '''''Bountiful''''' was a [[HV6 Harvester Factory]] manufactured by [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]]. It was deployed to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ando/Legends|Ando]] to catch and process [[Andoan mineral-fish]] as part of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Ando Project]].<ref name="Ando">{{JournalCite|11|The Ando Project}}</ref>
